property_summary: For any nonzero implementation and alloSettings set by the owner, create() deploys a fresh clone with code at a new address distinct from the implementation, while the stored implementation and alloSettings remain unchanged.
create() always reverts when the caller has not been granted program-operator status (and there is no way to grant it), regardless of parameters or stored implementation.
updateRoundImplementation rejects the zero address with a revert, and for any nonzero address stores it so that roundImplementation() returns exactly that address.
After initialization, any owner call to updateAlloSettings with an arbitrary address (including zero) stores it exactly, so alloSettings() returns that address.
After a successful initialize(), any subsequent call to initialize() reverts, guaranteeing the factory cannot be re-initialized.

property_summary: After initialization, the owner can set alloSettings to any address and the getter reflects it, while updating the round implementation to the zero address always reverts.
